notes.title: Our newest game is out now!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/db4b6199bf57274ed6052363adece00e0b10ca91.jpg[/img]

At long last, our newest game is now available! [b]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/b] brings fresh paramedic action and lets you save lives as a rookie paramedic today!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

As we celebrate launch, here are a few key things you'll want to know about the game:

[h3]1) It targets 4K/60fps on suitable hardware[/h3]
Yes, it's our first 4K game! We wanted the bright, colourful artwork and animation to really shine, so on capable systems (see the requirements on the main store page) the game can run up to native 4K resolution. Of course, in the Options menu, you can choose a variety of resolutions in both 16:9 and 16:10 ratios.

[h3]2) It's fully localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese[/h3]
Given that vibrant Neo Harbor City is inspired by co-designer Nancy's home town of Hong Kong, we wanted to make the game accessible to our Chinese-speaking friends and family. The localization team managed to even work in some language-specific puns!

[h3]3) It was designed with Steam Deck in mind[/h3]
Neo Harbor Rescue Squad runs at native 1280x800 resolution on Steam Deck and is fully controller-driven there, so if you have one, be sure to give it a go! We also are fans of Valve's portable system, so we wanted to make sure it was ready on day one.

Thanks for all your support so far. If you like the game, [b]please leave a review![/b] And if you have any issues, feel free to report them in the game's [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2342780/discussions/0/?snr=1_5_9_]Tech Help discussion category[/url].

See you in the field!
- Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Our new game launches Nov. 12!
notes.notes:
Hello, Home fans!

As we've mentioned before, we've been cooking something a little different for our fourth game — [b]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/b] is an arcade-style game about saving lives as a rookie paramedic that uses fast-paced minigames and a battle-like triage system to simulate saving lives in the field.

It's obviously a lot more colourful and decidedly uh, less [i]horrific[/i], than something like Home, but the BancyCo approach still shines through: it's got some mystery, great characters, an innovative UI, and a story very personal to us, the developers.

And this labour of love [b]finally launches on November 12![/b] (Of course, you can still play the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]free demo[/url] right now).

[b]Watch the new gameplay trailer here:[/b]
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AKADGZyXbyk&ab_channel=BancyCo

We hope you'll give it a shot on launch day (for a 10% launch discount, BTW!) and keep an eye out for the Easter eggs we've hidden in the game...

Thanks as always for your support!
Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Being HOME ALONE WITH YOU is WORSE THAN DEATH!
notes.notes:
As we celebrate the upcoming launch of our fourth game, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/url], we wanted to collect our first three titles for new and existing players. This bundle is a complete-the-set triple-pack, so if you've not played all of our previous titles, now is a great time to do so at a discounted price.


[h1]The games in this bundle[/h1]

[h2]😱 HOME - A UNIQUE HORROR ADVENTURE[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/215670/Home/

Awakened by an oncoming storm, you open your eyes to discover yourself in a strange, dark room – tucked away in a house that’s not yours. As you play the game, it changes – subtly, almost imperceptibly – to reflect your perspective. It's a horror game unlike any other, and as you'll discover, its truths are entirely subjective.

[h2]🚀 ALONE WITH YOU[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/564940/Alone_With_You/

Can love bloom on a doomed space colony? Alone With You is the tragic sci-fi follow-up to indie horror hit Home, in which you discover the fate of your crumbling installation with the help of a very emotive AI companion and four fully-realized holograms. Providing a rich story that adapts to your choices, Alone With You is the Space Quest-meets-OK Cupid adventure game you never knew you wanted – until now!

[h2]💀 WORSE THAN DEATH[/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1029100/Worse_Than_Death/

Run for your life, hide in the shadows, and use your wits to avoid shadowy creatures and uncover the terrible truths of your wretched home town. Solve devious puzzles to reveal the emotionally-charged story of Holly and her friends that will have you hooked until the very end!

Horror, sci-fi, pixel art, and deep storytelling — complete your collection today!

notes.title: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad demo available NOW!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

[b]FINALLY[/b] we can show you what we’ve been working on for these last few years! It took a bit longer than we planned, based on our usual game release schedule, but now you can see what we've been cooking!

We would love, love, LOVE for you to give the demo a try. It'll show you about 30 minutes of what the game has to offer — the frantic action, the upbeat humour, and the loveable cast of characters we've created for you. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/][b]> Download it from the game's main page[/b][/url]

[h2]Some notes about the demo:[/h2]
[list]
[*]A DualSense, DualShock, or Xbox controller is recommended (there's some weirdness with Switch Pro controllers right now that will be fixed)
[*]The demo can be played in up to native 4K!
[*]There may be some weirdness with windowed mode right now; we'll fix that too
[*]The demo lets you fail treatment scenes with no penalty; we just want you to have fun; you can stress out in the full game
[/list]

[h2]We made a wholesome game!?[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/7ac4b21d936e8bcb70ed4afc291616b5aa6d9842.png[/img]

We're super excited that Neo Harbor Rescue Squad joins the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/wholesomegames]Wholesome Games Steam Celebration[/url]. 🎉

For those who’ve played our previous games, you’ll notice a change in tone, and there’s a reason for that.
This game was conceived during the height of the pandemic. Initially, we were going to channel that into a dark mystery, just like our other games, but we struggled to make it fun. Maybe it was because neither of us had the mental capacity during those uncertain times. Eventually, we tried a different angle. We added a cast of colorful characters, including a smack-talking dolphin (don’t ask); that’s when we knew we’d hit the right note. 

So please enjoy this demo! Tell your friends, smack that wishlist button, etc. etc. — and thanks for your continued support. 🙏

Ben & Nancy

notes.title: Announcing our new game: Neo Harbor Rescue Squad!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=PMFicJOCIxU;full][/previewyoutube]

Hello, everyone! We can at long last can announce our fourth original game, [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]Neo Harbor Rescue Squad[/url]![/b]

This arcade-style action title fuses the mechanics of [b]popular medical-themed games[/b] from the Wii and DS era with fast-paced, challenging minigames so you get a taste of being a paramedic. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/4008416/fe695d3e3f19261a933eecaed0d138cb2d1b6bf5.gif[/img]

The Rescue Squad has long lived in the shadow of the Neo Harbor City's prestigious Fire Department, but no more! As the team's new paramedic rookie, players must respond to emergencies throughout the city, deal with difficult patients, and protect the squad's reputation against the machinations of news reporter Betty Woo!

[h2]Notable features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] 🩹 [b]Use our triage system[/b] to quickly monitor patients’ health, how much damage they’re taking, if they’re critical, and learn to prioritize treatment
[*] 🪟 [b]Quickly switch between different views[/b] to manage multiple patients across a variety of complex scenes
[*] 🛡️ [b]Use shields [/b]to temporarily protect your patients from damage, giving you some breathing room to strategize
[*] 🅰️ [b]Aim for a high rank[/b] with each emergency; be graded based on speed, skill, and the condition of your patients
[*] 💬 [b]Make dialogue choices[/b] to deal with the public, advance the story, and get to know your squadmates
[*] 🐬 Laugh through a story of [b]teamwork and friendship (and dolphins)[/b], inspired by real paramedic stories in Asia!
[*] 👀 Be a paramedic in [b]up to native 4K![/b]
[/list]

[b]Sounds exciting? Then [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/]wishlist the game today![/url] [/b]🙏 Your support means a lot to us and helps us reach more players!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2342780/Neo_Harbor_Rescue_Squad/

Curious about how/why we decided to make a paramedic action game? We'll be posting behind-the-scenes updates about our development process up until launch.

Thank you!
Ben + Nancy (BancyCo)

[*] hot-swap between keyboard/mouse and controller anytime

notes.title: UPDATE - v1.6.0 provides a big overhaul!
notes.notes:
Holy crap, people — did you realize that Home is [i]almost five years old!?[/i] And you continue to play, question, debate and enjoy it, which brings many a smile to our weathered faces.

Home gets a lot of under-the-hood improvements today, to make your playing experience better, and to future-proof the game as new players continue to discover it and dive in.

[h1]What's New in v1.6.0[/h1]
- Home now more seamlessly supports keyboard, mouse, Xinput gamepads and (NEW) PlayStation®4 DualShock®4 controllers; plug whatever you have in and use it; the game will adjust its prompts to match more accurately
- Home is now fully playable with a mouse/trackpad (except for that one puzzle that requires typing)
- new pause menu allows you to return to title screen or quit to desktop
- game now renders beautifully on 21:9 monitors!

[h1]Bug fixes and improvements[/h1]
- tweaked, higher-res, better-looking title and ending screens
- gamepads no longer rumble if not actively in use
- screenshots now work consistently [b]*[/b]
- better window mode switching (just hit F4)
- text boxes can no longer be skipped by accident! 
- locked doors consistently display "now unlocked" text
- a bunch of little "how is that still a thing?" fixes

[i][b]*[/b] Mac version sometimes takes "partial screenshots" — we are trying to find a way around this and will address this in a future update.[/i]

[h1]A message to the players[/h1]
We still can't believe how popular this game got since its launch, and how many of you have jumped in to try our brand of horror-mystery-adventure. We just wanted to say thanks for all the support these past years — we hope you'll continue to enjoy Home, and our other games.

:-)
Ben

notes.title: New game (Alone With You) launching February 9!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/4008416/cfcbb993969f8422ea8f29c3400e50c7114510e0.png[/img]

Hey, all! It's been a long time since I launched [i]Home[/i] here on Steam, and I appreciate all the players, discussions and friendly arguments this game has encouraged!

I'm pleased to announce that [b]Alone With You[/b], my newest title, is finally launching on Steam. You can [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/564940] view the store page and put it on your wishlist here.[/url]

I wrote a little intro post about [b]AWY[/b] over on that page, but here's a snippet:

[i][b]Alone With You[/b] is a "sci-fi romance adventure" — and it's a bit like a Star Trek episode crossed with a dating sim, but a whole lot more tragic. It's meaty (average 4–6 hours of gameplay, but it can be more!), and has lots to offer players who like exploring, learning about the world, and really getting to know some "remarkably well-written" characters ([url=ttp://www.gamespot.com/reviews/alone-with-you-review/1900-6416503/]Gamespot[/url] said that, not us).[/i]

Like [i]Home[/i], it's a narrative-focused game where your choices affect things, but this time around, the story itself is more detailed, more substantial, and will tug your heartstrings in all sorts of unexpected directions.

I'll be posting more behind-the-scenes details on the game leading up to launch, so I hope to see you there!

– Ben

I know it's been a (much too) long time coming, but Home for Steam finally gets achievements today.

These are available on both PC and Mac, and should give you some fun incentive to explore some alternate routes throughout the game.

As well, v1.5.1 delivers:

notes.title: Welcome: Home Dev s Spooky Romance Alone With You
notes.notes:
Oh, now this looks intriguing. A while back, Benjamin Rivers released Home, a side-scrolling horror experiment about building a character’s personality through moment-to-moment gameplay. Choices re-contextualized and even outright changed backstory elements, and the whole thing was just a really interesting way to tell a story. So then, what’s next for Rivers? Why, an equally experimental, er, dating sim, of course – but with fewer menus and more open exploration. Alone With You is about the lone survivor of a failed terraforming project and his/her AI companion. But there’s a sinister undercurrent creeping its skeletal fingers around the game’s mushy gushy heart. Trailer below.

notes.title: PlayStation Home Has Become The Weirdest Place In Gaming
notes.notes:
It feels like an age ago, and in gaming terms I guess it was. The launch of PlayStation Home, one of the cornerstones of the PS3's launch era, was meant to usher in a new kind of online interaction. A place where the connectivity of Xbox Live could be turned into a virtual world, blurring the lines between community and the games they play.

And for a while, this was the case! Sony live-streamed press conferences and shows into the service (which to its credit it still does), Warhawk tried to bring its strategic features into Home, and most of the junk you could buy was related to video games.

But over the years, Home has changed. It never really caught on. It's a profitable service for Sony (and the third-party companies creating content for it), sure, and people use it, but it's hardly the bedrock of the PS3 community it was supposed to be. It's certainly no Xbox Live, and even Nintendo's fledgling online service seems to have more meat on its bones.

And yet it remains. So who, then, uses Home in 2012? If we're going by the weird shit that goes on sale every month for the service, I'd have to say... I have absolutely no idea.

Below you'll find some of the items and add-ons made available for sale in the service over the last year or so. Note that I'm not cherry-picking the weird/creepy ones; the kind of bizarre content here reflects a tone that's consistent throughout the offerings, which I think more than any survey or market research is able to sum up the kind of person using Home these days.

It's like someone took The Sims, smashed it together with late 90s-Eurotrash and added a dash of Second Life, just for colour. The results are, well, if nothing else the most unique and baffling array of content you'll find on any modern console.

I'm not saying that what Home's current users are doing or enjoying (or, to be more precise, buying) now is wrong. If you've found an online home and you're enjoying it, that's awesome! And if I sound condescending in any way, that's not my intent. Just because something is different doesn't mean it's worse. I've simply grown genuinely and increasingly fascinated by the shift in tone Home's gone through in the last few years.

But boy, I look at stuff like this and I wonder what Phil Harrison, the platform's champion, thinks. Because I bet when he helped launch Home in 2007, this was not what he had in mind.

notes.title: A Pathological Inclusion: Indie Royale Halloween Bundle
notes.notes:
This is incredibly unfair to the other games in Indie Royale’s Halloween Bundle but the reason everyone should buy it is because Pathologic is in there. Ice-pick Lodge’s disease-ridden horror story takes place in one of the most bizarre and fascinating environments ever crafted, and the game is either brilliantly and intentionally brutal or beguilingly broken. Probably both. For what is just shy of £3.00 (at the time of writing), you’ll receive Pathologic, side-scrolling changeable adventure Home, characterful puzzler MacGuffin’s Curse, retro ARPG Evil Quest, and Telltale’s strongest Sam and Max series – The Devil’s Playhouse. But you only needed to know about Pathologic, right? There’s a video below, because bundles have videos now.

notes.title: Home Product Update
notes.notes:
What’s New:
• Home now fully supports Steam’s Big Picture Mode – play the entire game with your Xbox 360 controller from the terrifying comfort of your own couch, or continue to use a keyboard if you prefer.

• The most requested feature has been added to the game! Home now auto-saves your progress as you play, allowing for shorter play sessions if required. Continue where you left off, or start over from the beginning. The game still starts you from the beginning once you complete it, though—keeping the integrity of the experience while adding convenience for players who need it.

• Some things may not always be what they seem. As promised in previous missives, players may start to see their Home experience change ever so slightly the next time they play. Was that room there before? I thought that was locked... This is just the beginning for long-term fans of the game.

• Various other graphical tweaks and corrections to text and menus.

notes.title: Now Available - Home, 15% off!
notes.notes:
Home is now available on Steam and is 15% off until September 7th at 10AM Pacific Time!

Home is a unique horror adventure set in a beautifully-realized pixel world. It’s a murder mystery with a twist—because you decide what ultimately happens. Awakened by an oncoming storm, you open your eyes to discover yourself in a strange, dark room—tucked away in a house that’s not yours. As you play the game, it changes—subtly, almost imperceptibly—to reflect your perspective. It's a horror game unlike any other, and as you'll discover, its truths are entirely subjective.
